name: Leshrac
description: Leshrac, the Walker of Night, is a black-aligned planeswalker of unknown origin who plotted to conquer Shandalar and was finally captured in a mask by Nicol Bolas.

description_citations.text: "Walker of Night". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

summary.text: Leshrac, the Walker of Night, is a black-aligned planeswalker of unknown origin who plotted to conquer Shandalar and was finally captured in a mask by Nicol Bolas.

citations.text: "Leshrac". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Walker of Night". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Ice Age he was the master of Lim-Dul, who swore himself to Leshrac body and soul, and Leshrac later mutated him and cut off his hand in the last battle.

citations.text: Leshrac's Rite (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: At the Summit of the Null Moon Faralyn, Leshrac and Szat betrayed the other planeswalkers, and Leshrac killed Ravidel with Fire Covenant.

citations.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citations.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He escaped to Shandalar and started the War for Shandalar, but without his undead host he was defeated by Kenan Sahrmal.

citations.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: He rang the Grey Chime, which destroyed Telemar City, and Taysir later defeated him and imprisoned him in Phyrexia.

citations.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Taysir of Rabiah", section "Homelands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Later he manipulated Jeska to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir and accepted a copy of the Myojin's mask to fight Bolas.

citations.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Bolas had been playing him, and he impaled Leshrac, trapped his essence in the true mask and used it to close the Madaran rift, killing him.

citations.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Decades later Vaash Vroga lost control of Leshrac's mantle and his spirit emerged and departed.

citations.text: "Leshrac", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Vaash Vroga", section "Corruption by the mantle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Leshrac was killed when Bolas sacrificed him to seal the Madaran rift, though his spirit later emerged from the mantle Vaash Vroga carried and departed.

citations.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Leshrac", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
timeline.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chromium pledges to Faralyn and befriends Ravidel; Arcades Sabboth is killed by Kristina.
timeline.quote: Chromium once again pledged allegiance to a planeswalker

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Serving Faralyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Leshrac and Szat betray the others; Szat kills Chromium so they can escape to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: Szat killed Chromium, who was powerful enough to allow them to escape

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel lures six planeswalkers to Corondor with the Mox Beacon and forces them to battle in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: The planeswalker Ravidel used an artifact known as the Mox Beacon to lure other planeswalkers to Corondor.

citation.text: "Corondor", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel creates the Mox Beacon to lure Corondor's old enemies in the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: created the Mox Beacon to lure them to Corondor

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section ""Modern times"". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac sees a vampire army reluctantly led by Ihsan around 4500 AR.
timeline.quote: he saw a great army of vampires, reluctantly led by a giant in armor

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac sees Sengir's vampire army march through the Dwarven Gate on the eve of the Great Mending.
timeline.quote: The Baron was last seen at the head of this army, walking through the Dwarven Gate .

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Through the portal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swears his service to Leshrac and asks for power.
timeline.quote: "Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due."

citation.text: Dark Ritual (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swears himself to Leshrac, body and soul.
timeline.quote: Blood for blood, flesh for flesh, Leshrac, my lord."

citation.text: Leshrac's Rite (Ice Age, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Betrayers escape the Shard after Chromium and Ravidel die at the Summit of the Null Moon.
timeline.quote: No planeswalker died, but the deaths of Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel proved enough to let the betrayers escape.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac transforms Lim-Dul with the Master of the Hunt spell.
timeline.quote: Leshrac casts the Master of the Hunt spell on Lim-Dûl, transforming him into a mighty creature.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The knights defeat Lim-Dul with the Winds of Kataba and Word of Undoing; Leshrac leaves him in an Icy Prison.
timeline.quote: Leshrac is not pleased and leaves Lim-Dûl stuck in an Icy Prison

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Frozen Dead". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Faralyn hosts the Summit of the Null Moon with the planeswalkers trapped in the Shard.
timeline.quote: For ten centuries, they have been trapped within a tiny formation of twelve worlds

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szat kills Chromium Rhuell with Dark Banishing and combat breaks out.
timeline.quote: Szat follows through with Dark Banishing , killing the mighty dragon.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szat reveals he is in league with Faralyn and Leshrac and plans to silence Dominaria.
timeline.quote: He reveals that he was in league with Faralyn and Leshrac all along

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Faralyn uses Rhuell's death energy to open the rift; Lim-Dul escapes and Leshrac kills Ravidel with Fire Covenant.
timeline.quote: Leshrac casts Fire Covenant , bringing fiery harm to all present and killing Ravidel.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szat and Lim-Dul escape through a portal to Shandalar.
timeline.quote: a portal opens up to transport Szat and Lim-Dûl to Shandalar

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "Forever Silent the World". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trapped in the Shard during the Ice Age, Leshrac summons an elder dragon against Kristina of the Woods and plans to conquer Shandalar with Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: He wanted to conquer that mana -rich plane , and allied with Tevesh Szat to achieve this.

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac escapes to Shandalar and starts the War for Shandalar, but without his undead host he is defeated by Kenan Sahrmal.
timeline.quote: he was defeated by Kenan Sahrmal

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac is tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia, later freed.
timeline.quote: He was eventually tracked down by Taysir and imprisoned in Phyrexia .

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ring grants Lim-Dûl great power; he builds Tresserhorn and becomes a necromancer, with Leshrac and Mairsil manipulating him.
timeline.quote: The ring granted him incredible powers that not only allowed him to survive the blizzard but also to become a powerful necromancer.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gerda sells out Jodah, and Lim-Dûl muddles his memory and makes him research planes and ways to kill a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had Jodah also research ways to kill a planeswalker

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac discovers the plan and mutates Lim-Dûl, giving him horns.
timeline.quote: Leshrac discovered this and mutated his minion, giving him horns

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the last battle, Lim-Dûl faces Jodah under Mairsil's control, and Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dûl's hand and tears him apart.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl was turned into a living ball of raw flesh that Leshrac took with him off-plane

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon battle erupts among the planeswalkers; Ravidel and Rhuell die and Taysir and Kristina revive Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Taysir and his lover combined their magic to bring Ravidel back to life

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szat manipulates the battle between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion so that Storgard is damaged, and patronizes Lim-Dul with Leshrac.
timeline.quote: Szat and another evil planeswalker, Leshrac , acted as patrons to the necromancer Lim-Dûl during his war against Kjeldor .

citation.text: "Tevesh Szat", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir defeats Leshrac but cannot kill him and imprisons him deep in Phyrexia instead.
timeline.quote: he imprisoned Leshrac deep in hellish Phyrexia instead

citation.text: "Taysir of Rabiah", section "Homelands". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac visits around 4500 AR and sees a vampire army under Ihsan's Shade, hinting at Sengir's conquest.
timeline.quote: Leshrac saw a vampire army marching in the night at the reluctant command of Ihsan 's Shade

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac warns Lim-Dûl of the coming darkness.
timeline.quote: Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither."

citation.text: Dark Banishing (Pro Tour Collector Set, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kristina turns Taysir away and he turns to vengeance against Leshrac and Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: she has no choice but to turn him away

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Lim-Dûl's Battle, Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, until Leshrac cuts off Dûl's hand and takes him to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Leshrac took him to Phyrexia to be recreated

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Eternal Ice". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and Leshrac convinces Szat to imprison Daria in an Amber Prison rather than kill her.
timeline.quote: proposing that she instead be imprisoned within an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck dies fighting Ravidel and Leshrac flees; Taysir then confronts Ravidel, who nearly defeats his mentor until Teferi intervenes.
timeline.quote: Embereck perished in the battle, and Leshrac fled.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac rings the Grey Chime; Kristina grabs it and planeswalks to the Blind Eternities as Telemar is destroyed in a mushroom cloud.
timeline.quote: Kristina grabbed the chime and planeswalked to the Blind Eternities as Telemar went up in a mushroom cloud.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi refuses Leshrac's recruitment and sends Caliphear to warn Freyalise.
timeline.quote: Leshrac then steals some artifacts and spells from the island, ensuring that his visit is not a waste of time.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Embereck is destroyed and Leshrac flees; Taysir confronts Ravidel and is saved by Teferi.
timeline.quote: The weakened Embereck is destroyed, and Leshrac is forced to flee.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sandruu disintegrates Grenfell Mor; Freyalise separates Szat from the Chime and Leshrac decides to activate it.
timeline.quote: Grenfell nearly kills Kristina with a spell but is then disintegrated by Sandruu.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac rings the Chime as Kristina yanks it away and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.
timeline.quote: Leshrac rings the chime just as Kristina yanks it from his hands, and Telemar goes up in a mushroom cloud.

citation.text: "Planeswalker War (comic)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and put Daria in an Amber Prison instead of killing her.
timeline.quote: So instead he puts the girl in an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Planeswalker in Amber , by Jeff Grubb and Rags Morales". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Szat and Leshrac manipulate the planeswalkers into fighting; Rhuell and Ravidel are killed.
timeline.quote: and so was Ravidel

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Death and resurrection". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel and Taysir trap Leshrac in Phyrexia, but Szat stays out of reach.
timeline.quote: They found Leshrac and trapped him in Phyrexia

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Under the wings of Taysir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the time of the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, Faralyn, Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl invade Shandalar.
timeline.quote: They immediately began to wage war upon the plane, ready to claim it for their own.

citation.text: "Shandalar", section "Sahrmal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac mutates Lim-Dûl, revealing he forced the necromancer into his service.
timeline.quote: Leshrac mutates the necromancer by making him more animalistic and giving him horns

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah fights Lim-Dûl, revealed to be a blend of himself and Mairsil the Pretender; Lim-Dûl summons Leshrac, who rips him apart and takes him to the rogue plane.
timeline.quote: Leshrac rips the necromancer to shreds but keeps him alive during it all

citation.text: "The Eternal Ice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the last battle against Lim-Dul, Leshrac cuts off the necromancer's hand and the ruby ring holding Mairsil/Dul's mind seeks a new host.
timeline.quote: just after Leshrac has cut off the necromancer's hand

citation.text: "The Shattered Alliance", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kenan Sahrmal defends Shandalar, but Lim-Dûl is beheaded by Sahrmal's followers and survives by moving his soul to another body.
timeline.quote: Lim-Dûl had survived by transferring his soul into another body

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl", section "War for Shandalar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Faralyn arrives on Shandalar from the Shard, mocks Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl, and claims the plane for himself.
timeline.quote: He mocks them for trying to betray him and claims Shandalar for his own.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac, watching Faralyn's end, wards himself against other planeswalkers and vows to defeat Sahrmal and conquer Shandalar.
timeline.quote: He vows to defeat Kenan Sahrmal and conquer Shandalar for his own.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat and Lim-Dûl arrive; Lim-Dûl is entombed in stone, and Leshrac burns him in a fire spell, causing Szat to flee.
timeline.quote: Leshrac conjures an immense fire spell and seemingly obliterates the necromancer.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 1: Exiles In The Promised Land". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac returns and tells Szat that Lim-Dûl is sapping him with manabarbs; the bickering planeswalkers retreat as Sahrmal casts Whimsy.
timeline.quote: Disgusted and frustrated with Shandalar's bizarre mana, Szat and Leshrac make a hasty retreat.

citation.text: "Shandalar (comic)", section "Volume 2: The Threshold". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl swears himself servant to Leshrac.
timeline.quote: I am your servant and your slave.

citation.text: Leshrac's Rite (Classic Sixth Edition, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Under Leshrac's influence, Jeska uses Radha to seal the rift, costing Radha her potential to become a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Under the influence of Leshrac , Jeska used Radha to seal the rift, causing the warrior to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska, manipulated by Leshrac, forcefully closes the Zhalfirin rift, and the phased lands are lost to oblivion.
timeline.quote: the phased lands of Zhalfir were lost seemingly forever, cast into oblivion

citation.text: "Zhalfir (plane)", section "Phased out". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Radha kills Leshrac's shadow assassin Dinne il-Vec on Madara.
timeline.quote: Radha fought the shadow warrior

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lim-Dûl calls on Leshrac for the power he is due.
timeline.quote: Leshrac, my liege, grant me the power I am due.

citation.text: Dark Ritual (Deckmasters, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Leshrac warns Lim-Dûl's enemies will wither.
timeline.quote: Share this vision with your enemies, Lim-Dûl, and they shall wither.

citation.text: Dark Banishing (Coldsnap Theme Decks, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bolas seals the Madara rift using Leshrac as a sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas sealed the rift at Madara using the unwilling Leshrac as a sacrifice.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska falls under the mental control of Leshrac, who hopes to use her Phage powers against Bolas.
timeline.quote: unknowingly fell under the mental control of the insidious Leshrac

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Yavimaya a vision from Leshrac makes Jeska immolate Multani's physical form, and she then closes the rift.
timeline.quote: caused Jeska to break the connection and immolate

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Madara Leshrac ambushes Jeska, strips her Phage legacy and encases her in stone when she refuses to fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Leshrac encased her in stone to keep her from interfering

citation.text: "Jeska", section "Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac returns to Urborg, frees the Weaver King, and is offered a powerful artifact by the Myojin of Night's Reach.
timeline.quote: Here, he freed the Weaver King

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac takes over Jeska's mind and uses her and Radha to close the rifts in Yavimaya and Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Leshrac managed to get hold of Jeska's mind

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Madaran rift Leshrac strips Jeska of Phage's powers and attacks Nicol Bolas, paralyzing him and rotting his body.
timeline.quote: Leshrac and Bolas battled both by spells and claw

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac and Bolas fight from world to world, pieces of the dragon falling on several planes.
timeline.quote: Walking from world to world, Leshrac and Bolas fought

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas impales Leshrac, reveals he already defeated Night's Reach, traps Leshrac in the true mask and uses it to close the Madaran rift, ending him.
timeline.quote: effectively ending the Walker of the Night's existence

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas defeats Leshrac and imprisons him in a mask.
timeline.quote: the latter was defeated after an epic battle and was imprisoned in the mask of the Myojin of Night's Reach

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Time rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas closes the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac.
timeline.quote: The rift was closed second to last by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Rift", section "Madaran rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara.
timeline.quote: sacrificing Leshrac to seal the rift over Madara

citation.text: "Rift Era", section "The Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the Madaran rift.
timeline.quote: sacrificed Leshrac

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska returns to Dominaria seeking vengeance for Karn as Leshrac returns.
timeline.quote: Her friend and ally Karn is gone, and someone will pay.

citation.text: "Future Sight", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Centuries later the Sisters order Leshrac to leave their plane.
timeline.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane.

citation.text: "Kyodai", section "Future Sight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sisters order Leshrac Nightwalker to leave their plane.
timeline.quote: the Sisters stood in his way and ordered him to go away from their plane

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Future Sight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On the beaches of Madara the Myojin of Night's Reach offers Leshrac a copy of her mask, and Leshrac accepts the bargain to fight Bolas.
timeline.quote: Leshrac accepts the bargain.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jeska questions Jhoira, Venser and Teferi, then goes to Otaria where Leshrac proposes using Venser's and Radha's sparks to close the rifts.
timeline.quote: Leshrac proposes that Jeska use Venser's and Radha ’s latent planeswalker sparks to channel mana and close them

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac reveals he had been influencing Jeska, paralyzes her and drains her black mana with the mask.
timeline.quote: Leshrac paralyzes her and uses the mask of the Myojin of Night’s Reach to drain Jeska’s black mana and corrosive touch from her time as Phage .

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac duels Bolas, drains his black mana, defaces the Talon Gates and decays Bolas's body with Phage's corrosive touch.
timeline.quote: Neither planeswalker can noticeably harm the other until Leshrac defaces the Talon Gates

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas reveals he had been playing Leshrac, skewers him with his tail and traps his essence with the original mask.
timeline.quote: Skewering Leshrac with his tail, the dragon uses the mask to drain and trap Leshrac’s essence, winning the duel.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas restores Jeska, uses Leshrac's trapped essence to close the Madaran rift, killing Leshrac, and departs Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Bolas then uses Leshrac’s trapped essence to feed and close it, killing the defeated planeswalker.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Decades later Vaash Vroga loses control of Leshrac's mantle and his spirit emerges and departs.
timeline.quote: Stating that "the tether is complete", Leshrac's spirit emerged from the mantle and departed.

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Magic: Legends". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vaash loses control of the mantle, which briefly corrupts her before releasing Leshrac's soul.

citation.text: "Vaash Vroga", section "Corruption by the mantle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arcades is killed by Kristina in her duel with Leshrac in 2834 AR.

citation.text: "Arcades Sabboth", section "Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bani and soldiers attack Tevesh Szat; the real Kenan Sahrmal appears, and Szat and Leshrac leave Shandalar.

citation.text: "Bani Bakur", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Hamath", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Kristina of the Woods", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah duels Lim-Dûl, who summons Leshrac; Leshrac severs Lim-Dûl's hand and planeswalks away with him.

citation.text: "Lim-Dûl's Battle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac cuts off Lim-Dul's hand with the ring before Mairsil can take control.
timeline.quote: Leshrac, seeking extra power himself, cut off the necromancer's hand with the ring.

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Myojin asks Leshrac Nightwalker to help against Bolas and gives him a porcelain mask that draws black mana.

citation.text: "Myojin of Night's Reach", section "Post-Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a duel in Estark, Ravidel forces Leshrac to spend all his mana on counterspells, and Taysir puts him into an Oubliette.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir tells Leshrac he will use his life energy to re-enter Rabiah, having been refused by Kristina of the Woods.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As Ravidel and Taysir drain him, Leshrac casts a spell that saves his life; the portal fails and he remains trapped as an incorporeal shade, his excess energy flowing into the people of Estark.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Taysir visits Leshrac after his time on Ulgrotha, finds him full of hate, and leaves him imprisoned.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac manifests his hand and cuts Arlen's throat, confident he will soon escape using Ravidel's Mox Beacon.

citation.text: "Walker of Night", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leshrac entombs Lim-Dûl in stone for his failure, witnesses Faralyn's death, and vows to conquer the plane.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "War for Shandalar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
